title: Bee Removal in Pelham Bay, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in Pelham Bay, Bronx. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, attics, and ground. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Pelham Bay residents know that our neighborhood's proximity to Pelham Bay Park and abundant green spaces makes it a hotspot for wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees seeking nesting sites in homes and businesses. The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional stinging-insect nest treatment and removal throughout Pelham Bay, from the waterfront communities near City Island Bridge to the residential blocks along Westchester Avenue. Our licensed technicians locate the nest, treat it directly, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization — whether the nest is in a wall void, soffit, attic, ground burrow, or wood structure.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Pelham Bay for years, understanding the unique challenges of this northeastern Bronx neighborhood with its mix of single-family homes, apartment buildings, and proximity to natural habitats. Our licensed technicians use humane removal methods, offer transparent pricing of $350-$550, and provide same-day or next-day service to protect your family and property.
localContext: Pelham Bay's tree-lined streets, gardens near St. Theresa Church, and older homes throughout the neighborhood create ideal conditions for wasp and hornet colonies to establish paper nests in eaves, chimneys, and wall cavities. Properties near Pelham Bay Park and along the Hutchinson River Parkway are especially prone to yellow jacket ground nests and carpenter bee activity during spring and summer months when colonies are most active. The neighborhood's wood-frame construction provides ample gallery sites for carpenter bees, while mature landscaping and eave overhangs attract paper wasps and bald-faced hornets.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Pelham Bay home?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service throughout Pelham Bay. Once you contact us, we'll schedule an appointment at your convenience and typically complete the nest treatment, removal, and entry-point sealing within a few hours.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Pelham Bay?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.
